title: 별의 전령
prompt:
INPUT: attach this book's ending form card image (her closed state). If a second image fits, add her first approved form image for the face.

BOOK: «별의 전령» by 갈릴레오 갈릴레이. science · 1610년 베네치아 · 파도바 · 베네치아 종탑 → 파도바의 지붕 위 관측대. Source scope: "『시데레우스 눈치우스(별의 전령)』(1610) 전체".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

OUTPUT: the OPEN state of the attached image — the climactic scene of this stage. Keep her face, hair, body, costume, camera, framing and subject scale. Change the world around her into this scene: "검은 하늘에서 목성 곁에 일렬로 선 네 개의 빛과 그 궤적". She is the only person; the scene is carried by objects, environment, light, weather or a looming non-human presence. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the scene opens.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: keep both hands as in the attached image.
